blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Higher latitudes receive slanting solar rays, resulting in colder climates.
Lower latitudes receive vertical solar rays, resulting in warmer climates.
Variation in day length is significantly greater toward the poles.
Competitive exams frequently ask about the correlation between solar ray angle (slanting vs. vertical) and latitude climate patterns.
Remember that day length variation is minimum at the Equator and maximum near the Poles.
